name: print-social-red-grid-crop-star-sticker-psychology-post
title: Red post with cropped face tiles and outline stars behind a bold statement
whatItIs: A deep red portrait post where a close crop of a face is split into grid tiles with thin white lines, overlaid with hand-drawn white starbursts and a big white sentence that flows around the image, framed by tiny corner captions.
whatItMeans: Intense, intimate and emotional; the cropped skin and red tone feel raw yet stylish.
techniques: Crop tightly on facial features and split into a tile grid.
Scatter outline star doodles across the image.
Set a large bold sentence in white lowercase around the visual.

vocabulary.definition: An image divided into a grid of cells.
A star drawn as a line-only shape.
A single colour applied over a photo.
Text arranged around parts of an image.
